title: Man. Post. Cap. X: GAR.1 — Rom. 5.13 confirms all sinned in Adam; so it favors imputation
pass_a_gloss: Garissoles: we easily slip these snares. Point 1: that Rom. 5:13 confirms what the prior verse said—all sinned in Adam—is granted; and those words, he says, teach imputation of Adam’s actual disobedience. So the reason Paul confirms and clarifies in v. 13 cannot fail to favor imputation.
pass_b_english: GAR. We will easily extricate ourselves from these snares.
For, first: that by these words the Apostle confirms what he had said in the preceding verse is confessed, as we have already heard.
But he had said that all sinned in Adam—by which words, by clear reasons, we have maintained that the imputation of Adam’s actual disobedience is taught.
Therefore the reason by which the Apostle confirms and clarifies that in this verse 13 cannot fail to be favorable to imputation.
source_text: GAR. His pedicis facile nos extricabimus. Etenim 1. His verbis Apostolum id confirmare, quod superiori versu dixerat, in confesso est uti iam audivimus. Dixerat autem, omnes in Adamo peccasse, quibus verbis imputationem inobedientiae actualis Adae doceri, manifestis rationibus addiximus. Itaque ratio qua id confirmat & elucidat Apostolus hoc ℣. 13. non potest non esse imputationi favorabilis.

choices.choice: v.13 confirms all-in-Adam and favors imputation
